technology_name: ROBOT FOR HIGH VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL TRANSMISSION LINE INSPECTION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Autonomous Inspection Robot / Power Grid Drone alternative
problem_solved: Manual inspection of live, high-voltage long-range grid lines forces hazardous high-wire climbing operations and expensive utility line de-energization cycles.
description: An autonomous track-traveling inspection robot vehicle featuring dual-wheel rolling modules, a slacker-style line crawling linkage assembly, an array of retractable safety anchor wires, multi-walled guide pulleys, and a 5-DOF robotic manipulator arm.
applications: High-voltage electrical grid monitoring, automated utility transmission inspection, cross-terrain power sub-station surveillance, and predictive grid fault telemetry.
